mapper.select: SELECT icam20_std_date AS stdDate , icam20_item_type AS itemType , icam20_item_cd AS itemCode , icam20_item_nm AS itemName , icam20_koscom_cd AS koscomCode , icam20_isin AS isin , icam20_ksd_item_cd AS ksdItemCode , icam20_close_price AS closePrice , icam20_pre_close_price AS preClosePrice , icam20_market_type AS marketType , icam20_worker AS worker FROM icam20_price a1 WHERE icam20_item_type = '2010' AND icam20_std_date = #{stdDate} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM icam20_price a2 WHERE a2.icam20_item_type = a1.icam20_item_type AND a2.icam20_isin = a1.icam20_isin AND a2.icam20_item_nm != a1.icam20_item_nm )
